name: Koi mo H mo Obenkyou mo, Omakase! Oneechan-bu
original_name: 恋もHもお勉強も、おまかせ！お姉ちゃん部
source:
With bad grades, Kyousuke is in pinch. He will have to repeat a year if he cannot pass the exam at the end of the month. When his elder sisters know about it they immediately establish the Oneechan club for the sole purpose of helping him in his studies.

Kyousuke is grateful for their support but academic assistance from his Onee-chans is not enough. He need a strong motivation. Sexual motivation that is.

Let the (sex) study begins!
translation:
成绩糟糕的京介陷入了困境。如果无法通过月底的考试，他就得留级。当姐姐们得知这件事后，她们立刻成立了姐姐部，唯一的目的就是帮助他学习。

京介很感谢她们的支持，但姐姐们的学术辅导还不够。他需要强烈的动力。也就是性的动力。

让（色情的）学习开始吧！
